hook.name: PangeaFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 fee hook for token launch pools that takes the entire trading fee in the quote currency via swap delta adjustments — beforeSwap for buys (exact-in) and afterSwap for sells, with gross-up for exact-out swaps. Pools must be registered by authorized factories with a fixed fee rate (30–500 bps); liquidity additions are restricted to a designated locker address.
